arxiv-2112-08467.description: Abstract We report 350 pulsating variable stars found in four DECam fields ( ∼ 12 \sim 12 sq. deg.) covering the Antlia 2 satellite galaxy. The sample of variables includes 318 RR Lyrae stars and eight anomalous Cepheids in the galaxy.

arxiv-2211-09338.title: Chaos due to symmetry-breaking in Deformed Poisson Ensemble Journal: \JSTAT
arxiv-2211-09338.creator: Adway Kumar Das & Anandamohan Ghosh
arxiv-2211-09338.description: Abstract The competition between strength and correlation of coupling terms defines numerous phenomenological models exhibiting spectral properties interpolating between those of Poisson (integrable) and Wigner-Dyson (chaotic) ensembles. It is important to understand how the off-diagonal terms of a Hamiltonian evolve as one or more symmetries of an integrable system are explicitly broken.

arxiv-2212-11790.title: Normalized Contrastive Learning for Text-Video Retrieval
arxiv-2212-11790.creator: Yookoon Park, Mahmoud Azab, Bo Xiong, Seungwhan Moon, Florian Metze, Gourab Kundu, Kirmani Ahmed
arxiv-2212-11790.description: Abstract Cross-modal contrastive learning has led the recent advances in multimodal retrieval with its simplicity and effectiveness. In this work, however, we reveal that cross-modal contrastive learning suffers from incorrect normalization of the sum retrieval probabilities of each text or video instance.

arxiv-2401-04246.title: Scalable Normalizing Flows Enable Boltzmann Generators for Macromolecules
arxiv-2401-04246.creator: Joseph C. Kim, David Bloore, Karan Kapoor, Jun Feng, Ming-Hong Hao, Mengdi Wang
arxiv-2401-04246.description: Abstract The Boltzmann distribution of a protein provides a roadmap to all of its functional states. Normalizing flows are a promising tool for modeling this distribution, but current methods are intractable for typical pharmacological targets; they become computationally intractable due to the size of the system, heterogeneity of intra-molecular potential energy, and long-range interactions.

arxiv-2411-01989.title: Kinematic censorship and high energy particle collisions in the Schwarzschild background
arxiv-2411-01989.creator: A. V. Toporensky, O. B. Zaslavskii
arxiv-2411-01989.description: Abstract We consider near-horizon collisions between two particles moving freely in the Schwarzschild metric in the region outside the horizon. One of them emerges from a white hole. We scrutiny when such a process can lead to the indefinitely large growth of the energy in the center of mass frame in the point of collision.

arxiv-2510-13036.title: Repairing Reward Functions with Human Feedback to Mitigate Reward Hacking
arxiv-2510-13036.creator: Stephane Hatgis-Kessell, Logan Mondal Bhamidipaty, Emma Brunskill
arxiv-2510-13036.description: Abstract Human-designed reward functions for reinforcement learning (RL) agents are frequently misaligned with the humans’ true, unobservable objectives, and thus act only as proxies. Optimizing for a misspecified proxy reward function often induces reward hacking, resulting in a policy misaligned with the human’s true objectives.

pmc-12705504.title: MicroRNA Binding Site Polymorphisms in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Implications for Pathogenesis, Prognosis, and Therapeutic Response
pmc-12705504.creator: Sara Rezapour, Farin Khodam Mohammadi, Mahmoud Darweesh, Saeed Mohammadi, Saeid Afshar
pmc-12705504.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a major global health challenge, characterized by complex molecular mechanisms. This review focuses on the crucial roles of microRNAs (miRNAs) in HCC development, progression, and therapeutic response. The regulation of gene expression and several critical cellular processes is carried out by miRNAs.

pmc-13018375.title: Therapeutic potential of flower fragrance diffusion on heart rate variability among hospitalized patients
pmc-13018375.creator: Gurleen Kaur, Yogesh Kumar, Nirangjhana S, Vishnu Shankar Ojha, Ratandeep Biswas
pmc-13018375.description: Heart Rate Variability (HRV) is a non-invasive measure of autonomic nervous system activity and may be influenced by environmental odors. Therefore, it is of interest to evaluate the effect of flower fragrance diffusion on HRV in hospitalized patients. Thirty adults admitted to obstetrics and chemotherapy wards underwent baseline HRV assessment, 60-minute flower fragrance exposure and post-intervention HRV recording.

uslaw-usc-t36-s30905.title: 36 U.S.C. § 30905 — Exclusive right to emblems, badges, marks, and words
uslaw-usc-t36-s30905.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s30905.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 309 (Boy Scouts Of America). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation has the exclusive right to use emblems, badges, descriptive or designating marks, and words or phrases the corporation adopts. This section does not affect any vested rights.
